description: Add a practice account that posts nowhere, to try the flow. Its deliveries are simulated and marked as such. Refused where practice accounts are switched off.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

label.description: A name for the practice account.

mode.description: How its deliveries end: success (the default), expired (fails as a lapsed connection), ambiguous (outcome unknown) or retry (rejected twice, then succeeds).

name: accounts_create_test
title: Make a practice account
